spec.title: 022: The Sharing Layer: Xenia, Org Bundles & Compatibility (Overview, Phasing & Decisions)

summary.text: The operator's intent (2026-10-24 and 2026-10-25): Delphi is not a replacement for Claude Code. It accelerates humans working in a specific collaborative environment; with knowledge and understanding shared across a team, results get better, and the strategist can help a team cut through with ideas driven by consistent knowledge and goals. The critical chore is a **standard by which an organization's knowledge and skills are bundled for Delphi**, so a bundle can be defined as a plugin carrying one organization's knowledge and expertise, and teams can work against it, aligning on knowledge, perspective and strategy. Alongside it: define **xenia** (cross-install sharing of memory, knowledge, context and skills) more carefully, and make skill, agent and tool plugins **as widely compatible as possible** rather than inventing an incompatible format.
